## Tectonic Therapeutic to Participate in the Morgan Stanley Global Healthcare Conference


WATERTOWN, Mass., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Tectonic Therapeutic, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=hsvhVzKzi5hFdmfz7uABnhZLY2OWaI3ftLzZeltyu9RkTWStokJv4HcaJWT55tx7QWrrL_BGJ96UdGle3t9Heumh__oBy3JyLDjbj3J47Nk=) (NASDAQ: TECX) (“Tectonic”), a clinical stage biotechnology company focused on the discovery and development of therapeutic proteins and antibodies that modulate the activity of G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs), today announced that Alise Reicin, MD, President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the upcoming Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference.


**Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference**


Date: September 14, 2026


Time: 5:35 PM ET


Location: New York, NY


Format: Fireside Chat


Presenter: Alise Reicin, MD, President and Chief Executive Officer


Webcast:[Link](https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1774693&tp_key=49d6b0b0e4&tp_special=8)


The live fireside chat can also be accessed under “[Events & Presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=TvjCK_-Cz2O2eKE65UX7P1umoFQkb_AJkolBkc7YYbCoNRkkPimqPeGOGjlWi7iADE6sqBisrSv_ZpbHTGvXx7KKslqZbm50d7mzBCyd3vBcMhC4uCvlf3OGyaYcSlRH3KkQ_I-zbN4nOwv_Lrl_gauUDG4yPLrNMTE9iT0S_u4=) ” on the Investors section of the Tectonic website at[www.tectonictx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0XSwwV2CXOxEf8w7gh8grPfc4Kzi22mtL7ni5SW-Zxa2HiIuhU20_LCYGHapIKw4NYatNLTeF0D8AXa-JCqm_GEj7spHnHq5dxyIAYZEeDw=) . Once the live event has concluded, a replay of the event will be available on the Company’s website for approximately 90 days.


The Tectonic management team will host one-on-one meetings during the conference. Interested investors should contact their Morgan Stanley representative to schedule meetings.


**About Tectonic**
[Tectonic Therapeutic](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=hsvhVzKzi5hFdmfz7uABnng0HOT9fEvKSSRVnGuwn3nupPlR2sAIkWGWT-GRJkUOfZAJQQ4lGgRu-927l-g9bV2Y-aKYuFMxQuYQOX-xaYw=) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on the discovery and development of therapeutic proteins and antibodies that modulate the activity of GPCRs. Leveraging its proprietary technology platform called GEODe™ (GPCRs Engineered for Optimal Discovery), Tectonic is focused on developing biologic medicines that overcome the existing challenges of GPCR-targeted drug discovery and harness the human body to modify the course of disease. Tectonic focuses on areas of significant unmet medical need, often where therapeutic options are poor or nonexistent, as these are areas where new medicines have the potential to improve patient quality of life. Tectonic is headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts. For more information, please visit[www.tectonictx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0XSwwV2CXOxEf8w7gh8grB-0p1pUnQou3omBb6Y5PU8wjxhT7wvSyY6Vd4CYKJBix5oM1wDfhRE2BQ174wtLXm0zYpWKhyRiJAtYAlQZTp8=) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=W9059ItKkZNWPTKZQgwQ6J9wIvR420gyE_PKkSdIAkaxs2JOfPrsvKp-PbIPLU9m-jq8O6IZe9cFZUnJ7EDo0GNIlTB2hSc3gTw1wGw765Q=) .
